newsitem.title: USA: Innova Pure reaches investment agreement.
newsitem.headline: Innova Pure reaches investment agreement.

text.p: Innova Pure Water Inc said Tuesday it has reached an investment agreement with Innova Holdings LLC, a company owned by the Cayre family, which also controls the GoodTimes family of companies.
Separately, GoodTimes has agreed to provide Innova with certain sales and marketing assistance to sell to mass merchants.
The strategic alliance permits Innova Holdings to purchase one, two and three-year common stock warrants for an undisclosed amount, according to a statement released by Innova.
